page.layout: One page of text. Above the text: the dedication title, in italic, and a salutation line. Running head at the top. Page number at the top left. No margin notes.

main_text.l: REdit in urbem D. Abraham Ecchel-lensis, officio, propter quod huc vo-
re-liquit ; sperant hic cum bona Eminentiæ
de re pluribus aget cum Eminentia vestra
cum affectu commendarem, nisi scirem comm-
paucis ante diebus à Jesuita composito,
eumque ad eam aut misit aut mittit, ne-
cesse prorsus est, ut librum legat Emi-
contineri, aut quivis alius, nemo nobis est
crediturus, cùm in fronte gestet honori-ficum

page.notes: The large initial R is joined to "edit" as "REdit". Some letters are faint or speckled from the scan, but every word was readable. The punctuation after "credo" and "composito" is slightly unclear; I read them as commas.
